artifacts.notes: Printed pages 138-143 contain Homily XXIV on First Corinthians. Printed page 143 contains the manger and altar comparison used by the John 6 study.
artifacts.rights_basis: The underlying 1889 American printing is in the United States public domain by date of publication. The Internet Archive delivers a scan of that printing; the bytes are not redistributed here.
